verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any statement about how user data is used for model training. Two features come close but earn no credit as adjacent capabilities: the app accepts any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including self-hosted ones like Ollama or llama.cpp, and it keeps run history on the phone. Avoiding training would depend on the user choosing and running a local model, which is a user-side arrangement, not a documented product control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
